effects.before: The fixed host-admitted bound deploy path had no C1-linked bridge between exact preplan and incumbent deployment receipt.
effects.after: Before destination acquisition the private bridge binds C1 run/plan/home/principal/provider/artifact/resources and Ready; replay inspects the retained receipt/sidecar/result with no second provider apply. Other deploy shapes and public adapters remain separate.
effects.platform: Selected GNU/Linux bound completion/interruption tests; native macOS/Windows physical-root proof unrun.

effects.before: The public DeployError enum had no ProtectedReservation variant for a C.1/domain-bridge refusal before the first bound deploy effect.
effects.after: DeployError::ProtectedReservation is a publicly re-exported typed refusal carrying the reason a protected bound deployment could not prove its reservation; the fixed bridge that emits it remains crate-private. Downstream exhaustive Rust matches over DeployError may require a new arm.
effects.platform: Variant is compiled for Linux/macOS/Windows; selected GNU/Linux bound-deploy tests only, native macOS/Windows bridge behavior unrun.

user_impact.reason: A new variant in the public DeployError enum can require manual updates to downstream exhaustive Rust matches; the protected deploy bridge remains crate-private and does not migrate 1.0.x user-owned deployment state.

documentation_impact.reason: Developer API guidance must name the public ProtectedReservation error and exhaustive-match update, while release architecture distinguishes the fixed reserved deploy bridge/partial truth from ordinary public routes; final topic map pending.
